seed.prompt: Recompose the supplied source screenshot into a clean, complete 9:16 production frame for image-to-video generation. Remove all app UI, status bars, buttons, progress bars, card chrome, instruction text, captions, logos, and watermarks. Preserve the source's editorial illustration style, palette, subjects, and emotional meaning; do not drift to photorealism, and do not duplicate subjects or invent people who are not already in the source scene. Shot goal: Open on the frozen decision — a man suspended over a keyboard he cannot commit to — and establish the dark, watched, claustrophobic world of the story.. Required composition: Vertical recompose of the page-1 story art only, app header bar and page-progress dashes cropped away. The dark night cubicle fills the frame in deep plum and purple, the seated man in a dark button-up shirt held slightly right of centre in profile, one hand resting on the keyboard, his face lit cold by the pale-green glow of the monitor at his left. The dark looming silhouette of a standing figure sits just behind his shoulder, deliberately soft and unreadable. A pale rounded thought bubble with small simple line icons floats above his head near the top third. Cubicle partitions frame the edges; the empty desk surface and shadowed floor hold the bottom third quiet. Side padding is filled with a blurred, darkened extension of the same plum interior.. Planned motion context: Slow, continuous push-in toward the seated man, the frame easing very slightly leftward so he settles from off-centre toward centre as the shot closes. The looming silhouette scales marginally slower than the desk foreground, giving a faint parallax separation between the dread behind him and the lit workspace in front of him. No cuts, no whip — one unbroken creeping approach that never quite arrives.. Source support: Every element is taken from the page-1 analysis: the seated man at 440-680 x, the monitor with its glowing pale-green screen at left, the dark looming silhouette behind him, the thought bubble, and the dim night cubicle environment. The crop follows the asset's own CROP_TO_TEXT_AND_ART strategy and its note that UI is safe to remove, and the push-in plus shadow/foreground parallax are two of its three suggested_motion entries. The asset flags both the bubble icons' meaning and whether the silhouette is a coworker or symbolic as uncertain, so the shot describes them only as shapes and a dark figure without asserting either reading.. Source visual description: Flat vector illustration of a man in a dark office cubicle at night, sitting at a desk typing on a keyboard in front of a glowing monitor. A pale speech/thought bubble above him contains a clock icon and a crossed-out target-with-arrow icon. A dark shadowy silhouette of a figure looms behind him. Purple and deep-plum palette.. Source art description: Night office cubicle; man typing at a glowing monitor with a clock/blocked-goal thought bubble and a looming shadow behind him. Narration context (for mood and meaning only, never to be written into the image): Mark's finger hovered over the delete key. The resignation letter was already written.. CHARACTER SUBSTITUTION. The FIRST image is the source scene described above. The SECOND image is a character reference. The character reference images show the person only -- never copy their plain background, standing pose, framing, crop, or layout into the scene. The source scene already contains this human figure: Illustrated man at a computer, tense posture, looking at screen Redraw that one figure as the referenced character, matching their hair, build, colouring and clothing, and keeping the source figure's existing pose, body angle and head direction exactly as drawn -- do not turn, lift or rotate the head, and do not add a face that the source does not show. Draw the character in the character reference's own illustration style, but keep everything else exactly as the source scene draws it: the scene's art style, palette, line quality, texture, lighting, background, props and composition are unchanged. Do NOT restyle the scene to match the character. Adapt only the character's pose, body angle, scale and clothing to the figure already occupying that spot, so the character sits or stands exactly where that figure stood and carries the same emotional beat. Replace that ONE focal figure only. Every other person in the scene -- background silhouettes, crowds, secondary figures -- stays exactly as the source draws them. Add no second character and no duplicate of the character anywhere in the frame. FINAL RULE, overriding anything above: render NO text of any kind -- no words, letters, captions, titles, quotes, signage, or handwriting, anywhere in the frame. If any description above mentions a text overlay, on-screen wording, or a line that fades in, that belongs to a later compositing step, not to this image -- produce the clean plate without it.

result.qa_summary: All three previews inspected. Preview 1 reproduces the approved seed faithfully: deep plum/purple night cubicle, man right of centre in profile with hand on the keyboard, pale-green monitor glow from the left, soft dark standing silhouette behind his shoulder, pale thought bubble with clock and struck-through target icons in the upper third, cubicle partitions framing the edges. Preview 2 shows a smooth continuous push-in with the frame easing slightly leftward so he moves from off-centre toward centre, and the looming silhouette scaling marginally slower than the lit desk foreground, giving the intended faint parallax between the dread behind him and the workspace in front. No app UI, no text, captions, logos or watermarks in any frame; no extra, duplicated or invented subjects; no warped hands, furniture or geometry. Style holds as flat editorial vector in the source palette with no photorealistic drift. Character stability confirmed across every preview frame: the same dark curly hair, full dark beard and moustache, brow, nose and mouth shapes, skin tone and blue button-up shirt persist without melting, warping, face swapping, drift toward a different person, or dissolving into a blank or generic figure; the face remains clearly visible in profile, in focus and detailed even at the closest framing. Background silhouette stays as drawn. Approved.
